import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert flipper_length_mm from text to numeric, handle negatives and out-of-range
    df = df.copy()
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix negative values (likely data entry errors) by taking absolute value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Cap values to valid range [170, 235]
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].clip(170, 235)
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Standardize island names: remove extra spaces and fix case
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Ensure species is in allowed list (though profile says all are valid)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Clean the data first
    df = clean(df)
    # Group by species and compute average flipper length
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    # Return as dict with species as keys
    return result
